resources.string: You can\'t sleep. It happens, and it\'s okay.
Lying in bed waiting for sleep pushes it further away. Here is what to do.
Get up and go to another room.
Do something calm, in soft light, away from screens.
Go back to bed when you feel sleep coming.
Chime active: set your phone down with the screen on (brightness is at minimum and the clock is hidden) or face down. A soft chime will sound in about twenty minutes.
The chime has sounded: if your eyelids feel heavy, you can go back to bed.
This screen will close by itself.
